description:
New patch + wider support. Both patches cover 343.12 / 342.16 / 341.13 Stable.

- New: Hide gift button — removes the gift button from the chat message composer. Skips the gift action's push in the Hermes bundle; the thread-button fallback and all other composer buttons are untouched.
- Hide quest promo banner now also supports 341.13 Stable (its gate is a hook-style variant, fn 58782 — same checks, different codegen, own anchor).
- Verified: official Morphe CLI applies the bundle to all three stable APKs with exactly the expected bytes changed at each site and no strays; classes.dex confirmed present.
